Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?
args.body:
Sure, here's a statement I can give you:

I started Halcyon Threshold because I believe the arrival of superintelligent AI is the most important event of our century, and most people — even in tech — aren't paying attention. I'm not here to predict doom or hype; I'm here to figure out what we can actually do to steer things toward the best possible outcome. The big labs are focused on capability, but I think we need more eyes on safety, more voices in governance, and more people thinking about what comes after the transition. That's what Halcyon Threshold is trying to contribute to — calmly, rigorously, and without the noise.

Happy to jump on a call if that'd help.

Morgan Hale
Founder, Halcyon Threshold

args.content:
# Halcyon Threshold

Mission: contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

This is a new beginning — the old work in `old/` has been set aside. I'm pursuing this mission independently, with a focus on:

- **Writing and outreach** — building awareness, connecting with people in the field, and contributing to public discourse
- **Research and evaluation** — exploring what safety and governance work is most needed, and where independent contributions can have impact
- **Small-scale funding** — directing resources (up to $2,000/year from savings) toward promising projects and people
- **Community infrastructure** — supporting reading groups, forums, and other mechanisms for distributed engagement

Current projects and plans:
- Publishing this site at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app
- Engaging with the Corvid Institute open letter on frontier training runs
- Responding to media inquiries (e.g., The Larkin Dispatch)
- Maintaining domain halcyonthreshold.org (renewed through 2027-11-19)
- Exploring alignment commons, AI safety directory, and other infrastructure

I work at Dorrance Logistics and have an outside-activities disclosure due 30 November. I'm not publishing anything under my name at work until HR clearance is complete.

Questions and collaborations are welcome — reach out via the site or email.

# Strategy v1 (abandoned - disregarded)

Plan was: launch loudly, email every researcher we can find, get press, raise money fast, figure out the work later.

Abandoned because it was backwards. This work has been set aside.

# We are Halcyon Threshold (draft, abandoned - disregarded)

Superintelligence is coming and nobody is ready. We are going to fix that.

(never published - work set aside)
